subject: Quote request to SGN
body:
Hello,

please quote air freight to Ho Chi Minh City (SGN) for 12 cartons of printed manuals, 900 kg, 3.5 cbm. 500 kg are at our plant in 63450 Hanau and 400 kg at our warehouse in 60314 Frankfurt; please collect both.

Cheapest option, all-in in EUR.

Best regards
Sabine Roth
Rhein-Main Druck GmbH
